calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-12-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of Two Minors.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: Cynthia Herbert/Sajja, CSR: Vicki Gross.
Petitioners Berhane Tesfu and Alganesh Tekle, are appeared in proper as Guardian Ad Litem for the Minors: Feven B. Tesfu and Nardos Berhane Gebremichael, were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name for the two minors were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minors to: Feven Tesfu Berhane and Nardos Tesfu Berhane.
Decree signed in open court.
